title: Activity log
description: list_events and the resource dayhand://activity (dayhand log): task changes oldest first, and the cursor to continue from (since 0.10.0).

action.description: create, update, setStatus, setNow, complete, repeat, archive, delete, restore, import, claim, renewClaim, release (values may be added)

actor.description: app, cli or agent (values may be added)

actorName.description: The key's or client's name; null for the app

by.description: app, cli, agent or agent: <name>, as history shows it

before.description: Changed fields before the change, or null

after.description: Changed fields after the change, or null

nextCursor.description: Pass as since next time to get only the changes after these; an opaque string starting with c

hasMore.description: true: more changes after nextCursor are already there; call again with since: nextCursor
